LanguageData.LP_ElementalFocus_Fire.label: blaze charm
LanguageData.LP_ElementalFocus_Fire.description: A mithril amulet set with a red crystal that feels warm in the left hand. When worn by a blaze bloodline genasi or a genie: spark cooldown halved, fire damage halved again (taking only a quarter in total). Worn by others: flammability halved. Only blaze bloodline genasi can make it at the enchanting table.
LanguageData.LP_ElementalFocus_Water.label: tide charm
LanguageData.LP_ElementalFocus_Water.description: A drop of never-drying water sealed in a mithril frame. When worn by a tide bloodline genasi or a genie: water stream cooldown halved, fire-quenching area expanded to 5×5. Worn by others: gains movement in water (no slowdown in shallow water and marsh). Only tide bloodline genasi can make it at the enchanting table.
LanguageData.LP_ElementalFocus_Earth.label: stone charm
LanguageData.LP_ElementalFocus_Earth.description: A heavy charm stone polished from adamantine. When worn by a stone bloodline genasi or a genie: mining speed raised from ×130% to ×160%. Worn by others: mining speed ×115%. Only stone bloodline genasi can make it at the enchanting table.
LanguageData.LP_ElementalFocus_Air.label: gale charm
LanguageData.LP_ElementalFocus_Air.description: A mithril ring wrapped with ever-fluttering cloth strips. When worn by a gale bloodline genasi or a genie: wind leap cooldown halved, move speed raised from ×110% to ×120%. Worn by others: move speed ×105%. Only gale bloodline genasi can make it at the enchanting table.
LanguageData.LP_IceDevilStinger.label: ice devil tail spike
LanguageData.LP_IceDevilStinger.description: The tail spike left behind when an ice devil is banished to the Nine Hells, bitingly cold to the touch and never melting. Black Network and Red Wizard merchants will buy it.
LanguageData.LP_BalorHeart.label: balor heart
LanguageData.LP_BalorHeart.description: The heart left behind when a balor crumbles, like a still-beating lump of lava. Black Network and Red Wizard merchants will pay a high price for it. (It may later be used to forge a flame tongue.)
LanguageData.LP_WonderLamp.label: genie lamp
LanguageData.LP_WonderLamp.description: An old brass oil lamp engraved with incomprehensible runes. Right-click "Rub the lamp": a dormant lamp summons a genie to join the colony (randomly fire, water, earth or air); while the genie is out the lamp is "occupied"; when the genie is downed or killed it returns to the lamp and the lamp is "dim" for 15 days, after which the same genie can be rubbed out again; a genie in the lamp is cut off from the world (no frostbite, no hunger, can't die) and comes out at full condition; while dim, select the lamp to spend 1000 silver and wake it at once.\n\nThe lamp must stay in your hands: if sold, stolen or destroyed, the genie leaves a day later. Cannot be crafted; Black Network caravans always carry one, and Red Wizard merchants occasionally have one too.
